subject: Re: Kickoff: BRAC - offline RL from logged interactions
body:
Status + the risk that will shape the go/no-go.

Reproduction: complete. SAC partial policies collected data as in the paper, and our offline BRAC runs on HalfCheetah-class tasks match the published pattern - the value-penalty variant with a KL divergence is the most robust config, and the Q-ensemble mainly helps on the noisier datasets.

Internal feasibility: early runs on the anonymized pilot logs are mixed. The regularization does its job - policies stay near the behavior distribution - but that's also the problem: our logs are narrow, so the learned policy improves modestly (+4% on the offline evaluation metric) and won't discover anything the pilots never tried.

Risk to state plainly for the go/no-go: offline eval itself. Our off-policy estimates have wide confidence intervals, and without a small live A/B we can't validate them. That's a product/policy question more than a research one.

Carmen
